ruleChain.name: IoT Data Processing Chain
ruleChain.description: Complete IoT data processing pipeline with MQTT input, JavaScript filtering/transformation, PostgreSQL storage, and RabbitMQ output

additionalInfo.description: Receives IoT sensor data from MQTT broker

Transforms raw sensor data and calculates derived values
Distributes processed data to multiple downstream processors
